37 weeks and 6 days = 37*7 + 6 = 259 + 6 = 265 days.  
Start date: 1339-02-08 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 8th February 1339).  
Add 265 days: 1339 is not a leap year (1339 mod 4 = 3).  
Days in Feb 1339 = 28, so from Feb 8: 28 - 8 = 20 days left in Feb → 20 days used.  
265 - 20 = 245 days remaining.  
March (31) + April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) + September (30) + October (31) = 31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31 = 245 days exactly.  
So end date is 1339-10-31.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1339-10-31
